# Population-controlled launch without a clean-zero event

Author construction. This replaces the nonuniform forced-zero minorization in COLD_LAUNCH_AND_DELAYED_PHYSICAL_REPAYMENT.md. It earns a common physical episode with BOTH cold and hot inventories unbounded. It is not global recurrence: high anchors, arbitrary initial active phases and large pair-difference faces still require their own compatible operations.

## 1. Complete destination of this operation

For the same two ordered blocks plus rate2/rate1 conservative pair, start at

    x=(0,b,c,0,e,f), b,c,e,f>=0, N=b+c+e+f.

There are fixed eps>0,D,N0 depending only on the positive raw rates, such that for every input with N>=N0 and

    |b-c|,|e-f| <= eps N,                                  (S1)

an actual episode has

    E[sigma+D Z(actual output)^2]<=D Z(input)^2,
    Z(x)=15+|x|-m(A)-m(D),                                (S2)

with the SAME m=(0,2,4,7,7,...) as before. All interruptions and endpoints are included. No bound on b+c or e+f is assumed. One pair may be bounded, may grow as any sublinear power of N, or may be comparable to the other. The episode has E sigma<=C(N+15) and bounded total Delta Z, with constants independent of all four input inventories.

## 2. Change the launch stop: a seven-state ACTUAL controller

Run only until the FIRST unexpected source OR the first overlap A>0,D>0. Before that stop the conservative pair is disabled. A normal I-cycle preserves its residual (b,c), a normal II-cycle preserves (e,f), and at most one anchor is positive. Therefore the complete genuine normal process is the seven-state star

    00, 10,20,30, 01,02,03.

This is not a truncated inventory controller: the four unbounded inventories are exact fixed residual parameters until the stop. Every actual competing raw source is either a transition of this star or an explicitly retained exit. Every normal transition preserves Z exactly. Thus there is NO unbounded launch-population loan to estimate; the stop was chosen before such a loan can accumulate.

# The star episode also starts at a genuine phase1 input

The proof of UNBOUNDED_STAR_LAUNCH_AND_REPAYMENT.md applies unchanged to an ACTUAL input

    x=rho+y1+z0, or x=rho+y0+z1,

where rho has zero anchors, nonnegative hidden coordinates, and the same small-relative-difference cone. The physical receiver is still Z=15+|x|-m(A)-m(D)=15+|rho|.

The only initial-phase-sensitive step is the crossing inequality r3 E T3<=r1 E T1. Starting at phase1 preserves it EXACTLY: every completed phase3 transition still requires a prior phase1 transition. The direct occupation identity between a neutral phase1 source and a clean overlap is also unchanged. Every launch exit remains included, so the same uniform productive probability and fixed downstream repayment apply. Starting off00 adds only a bounded expected time before absorption or phase00, since the launch stopping hazard there is at least alpha_0+beta_0. The physical mean remains O(|rho|+15).

This is an acquired extension for phases00,10,01, not a declaration that arbitrary active phases have the same crossing count. In particular phase2 and phase3 initial conditions can contribute an unpaired phase3 crossing and need additional repayment analysis.

# A cold-head launch and repayment operation at the same physical receiver

Author derivation. This removes the specific bounded-cold-launch obstruction for the six-species diagnostic. It does not cover every face of that network, and does not prove arbitrary weak-reversibility recurrence. The ordinary positive-recurrence baseline for each uncoupled degree-seven block is complex balance; quantitative actual return/occupation bounds below use the already banked GLOBAL_ORDERED_CYCLE_THEOREM.md at its recorded scope.

## 1. Input and complete output contract

Fix a finite R. The input has (A,B,C) in a fixed finite set H_R, D=0, E,F large, and |E-F|<=R. Both inventories E,F are comparable to their sum automatically for large sum. The roles of the blocks can be interchanged. All raw rates are fixed positive; the conservative pair has rates2 and1 as before.

Use the SAME physical function from BALANCED_NORMAL_CELL_PHYSICAL_EPISODE.md:

    Z(x)=15+|x|-m(A)-m(D),
    m(0)=0,m(1)=2,m(2)=4,m(a)=7 for a>=3,
    U(x)=D_R Z(x)^2.                                      (C1)

There are acquired finite D_R and a finite threshold such that an actual stopping episode satisfies

    E[sigma+U(actual output)]<=U(input)                    (C2)

for every sufficiently large input in this cold-head family. EVERY failure and interruption below is an actual endpoint received by (C1). No favorable receiving composition is assumed. The episode's observation length may grow with the hot population.

## 2. A quantitative banked consequence: cold return jump moments

For an autonomous ordered block, the banked equation(20) gives for each u>1 a proved bound

    G_u(x)=E_x integral_0^tau0 (1+q)u^M dt <=C_u+2t^M.

Its constants are bounded by the acquired finite-head trace construction; this is not an unevaluated expectation offered as numerical data. The same bound gives every polynomial moment of the genuine jump count J to zero. Inductively, if E_x J^(p-1)<=C v^M, the integer identity

    J^p <=p sum_(k=0)^(J-1) (J-k)^(p-1)

and the strong Markov property at genuine jumps imply

    E_x J^p <=pC E_x sum_(k<J) v^(M_k)
              =pC E_x integral_0^tau0 q v^M dt
              <=pC G_u(x),  u>v.
